MongoDB Software Lifecycle Schedules

The lifecycle schedules below form a part of MongoDB’s Support Policies. They include releases of MongoDB Server, MongoDB Ops Manager, MongoDB Search and Vector Search, and MongoDB Atlas cloud and specify the end-of-life date for each.

MongoDB Drivers released more than 3 years after a MongoDB Server version’s end-of-life date will not be compatible with that server version.
